content: godbus has no auto-reconnect: closing a Conn closes channels passed to Signal()/Eavesdrop (pkg.go.dev godbus) - a closed signal channel IS the disconnect signal; operations unblock with ErrClosed. Pattern: watch signal channel close, then re-dial (dbus.Connect/ConnectSession), re-export objects, re-add match rules. For goswitch: ibus-daemon restart drops the private-bus connection and kills spawned engines anyway (state loss must be tolerated); session-bus watchers (input-sources, goswitchctl API) need explicit reconnection loops.
